_readme: Bare English left in learner-facing templates by the 2026-09-03 i18n sweep — text the sweep could not key mechanically because it is spliced around a {{ }} value, or broken across inline markup, or lives in a file outside the mint scope. It is real debt, listed honestly rather than hidden. THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK: noBareEnglish.test.ts fails on an entry that no longer matches anything, so keying a string means deleting its line here. Never add a new string to this file — wire it, or allowlist it in untranslatable.ts with a reason.
